claims.formal_scope: exact rational and integer additive composition with budget guards
blocking_gaps: composeEps/composeEpsRat are an integer/rational additive-ledger surrogate, not a full measure-theoretic RDP accountant
gaussianRDPBound asserts the Gaussian mechanism's (alpha, alpha/(2*sigma^2))-RDP bound as an existence witness, not derived from the Gaussian density's Renyi divergence from first principles

RDP_sequential_composition covers independent-mechanism composition only; adaptive composition is now separately covered by RDP_adaptive_composition -- NOT via the expectation-based chain rule formula this gap previously cited (that formula is a KL-divergence-specific identity, not valid for Renyi divergence at general order; a Mathlib feasibility scout confirmed no Renyi/KL/f-divergence content exists anywhere in Mathlib to build the expectation-based route on regardless). RDP_adaptive_composition instead proves the standard literature result (Mironov 2017 Prop 1): a uniform/worst-case bound over the first mechanism's realized outputs, which strictly generalizes RDP_sequential_composition (setting the second mechanism's conditional distribution constant across the first mechanism's output recovers it exactly)

claims.formal_scope: redundancy and Chernoff-style exponential liveness model
blocking_gaps: current model is an integer/rational Chernoff-bound surrogate; full probability-measure and stochastic-process formalization remains roadmap work
abstract constant-operation verifier cost model only; not a full Groth16 succinctness/soundness or q-SDH security formalization
internal/zksnark_verifier.go's genesisVK is not derived from any circuit's trusted setup, so the runtime verifier cannot yet attest to arbitrary submitted data -- see that file's own doc comment

internal/zksnark_circuit_verifier.go now provides a real circuit-derived VK (a genuine groth16.Setup over a compiled MiMC preimage-knowledge circuit) closing the prior gap for a new, additive verifier path, but: (a) the Setup is a single in-process run, not a production multi-party ceremony; (b) it is not yet wired into any production call site (pyapi CGo exports, internal/hybrid, internal/batch/aggregator all still use the original zero-public-input genesisVK path); (c) the Lean model in Theorem5Cryptography.lean is unchanged and still describes only the abstract constant-operation cost model, not this circuit

full Groth16 succinctness/soundness/q-SDH formalization was investigated for feasibility (not attempted blind) and found intractable in bounded scope: a repo-local grep of the pinned Mathlib source (proofs/.lake/packages/mathlib, matching lakefile.lean's v4.30.0-rc2 pin) confirms real, non-stub elliptic-curve group law (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/) and generic finite fields/bilinear maps exist, but there is zero pairing/Tate-Weil machinery (no hits for a cryptographic pairing, Tate pairing, or Weil pairing anywhere in Mathlib) and zero computational-hardness formalization (no discrete-log or q-SDH hardness infrastructure) -- the two pieces that actually carry Groth16's security content. The one extension that IS Mathlib-groundable without those (an explicit-extractor knowledge-soundness restatement) was assessed and rejected: it would reduce to a near-verbatim restatement of the already-proven theorem5_verifier_soundness (whose witness ⟨proof.proof_payload, 1⟩ is already, in effect, a constructive extractor), adding a differently-named theorem with no new content -- exactly the kind of inflation this repo's formal-verification effort exists to avoid. Decision: keep this claim scoped as the abstract constant-operation model; do not attempt a pairing-based extension without new Mathlib pairing/hardness infrastructure landing upstream first.
